body.statement: For every factual cell \(v\), first compute \(\boldsymbol\gamma^{\circ}=\mathsf N(\boldsymbol\gamma)\), its normalized context set \(\mathcal H\), and \(h=|\mathcal H|\). The compiler \(\mathsf C_r\) then computes exactly the joint truth support \(A_v\), one sparse witness for every reachable terminal truth vector, and the labels \(\ell_g(v),u_g(v)\) in \(B_h2^r(r+1)^{h-1}\operatorname{poly}(N_{\mathrm{in}})\) time including normalization. By the canonical-carrier equivalence, over the standard parent-subset class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ord}}\), \(\Theta_g(p)=[L_g(p),U_g(p)]\). Each endpoint is attained by a shared-exogenous model with one atom of mass \(p(v)\) for each \(v\in\operatorname{supp}(p)\), and every intermediate value is attained by mixing the endpoint models. No termwise optimization replaces \(A_v\).
body.justification: Joint flags preserve cross-term dependence while sparse cellwise witnesses turn exact normalized feasibility into sharp partial identification.
body.gap: Rossetto--Antonucci establish the same sharp order-only identified set by completed response signatures, while Zhang--Tian--Bareinboim use broader canonical polynomial programs; neither gives this alphabet-independent joint compiler.
body.consumer: Explicitly unnested mediation scores and other rational combinations can be bounded without the invalid practice of optimizing their conjunctions separately.
